### `research/norm_probe/run_norm_probe.py` (456 lines)
- PURPOSE: E-normprobe-1. CPU-only static probe of the INPUT normalization of 32-bar H/L/C windows: V0 current (window_scale, robust), V1 log-returns + global Min-Max, V2 + Standardization, V3 / trailing sigma clip 5, V4 = V2 clipped at 5, V5 train-f…
- TAGS: input normalization, log returns, min-max, standardization, effective rank, near duplicates, linear probe, representation collapse, bootstrap month blocks, e-normprobe-1
- PITFALLS: All statistics (Min-Max range, mean/std, quantiles) are fitted on bars with time <= TRAIN_END only. A window is dropped for ALL variants if bars t-47..t+1 touch a gap/NaN or a flat zero-volume run >= 168 h. Code package modules are NOT imported (they run in one shared namespace): V0 re-implements data/normalize.py process_windows for H/L/C and tests/test_norm_probe.py pins it to the real function.
